title: Benchmarking Spatial Reasoning Abilities of Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing object accuracy (OA) for text prompts containing single objects versus multiple object conjunctions and relational texts to measure the models' preference for generating single objects.
Comparing the generation accuracy of the first mentioned object in a text prompt versus the second mentioned object to identify a bias toward earlier text tokens.

Correlating spatial reasoning metric scores (VISOR) and object accuracy with the real-world probability of object co-occurrence (derived from the MS-COCO dataset) to measure the models' bias toward likely real-world object combinations.
